title: Stories of Your Life and Others
author: Chiang, Ted
review:
The ideas in this book are incredible. The biggest con is that once you get invested in the story it goes on to the next one, but that's just the effect of the short story format. I'd read a full novel of any of the stories in this book.

The diversity of the stories is a strong point, each one is fairly unique and different than the others and all make you think of different aspects of society, religion, and technology like all good sci-fi should.
